fear_days.definition: A picker fear day is a session SPY fell 1% or more, closed under its 50-day average, or saw its 20-day volatility (or the VIX) rise above 1.5 times its yearly median.

changes.flips_why: No flip: the fear-day state and every fund's move regime match the prior lineup.
